claims.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.sizeMean_eq_closedForm
claims.source_statement:
theorem sizeMean_eq_closedForm (n : Nat) :
    sizeMean n = Resources.QuickSortMean.closedForm n

claims.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.sizeMean_eq_harmonic
claims.source_statement:
theorem sizeMean_eq_harmonic (n : Nat) :
    sizeMean n =
      8 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (harmonic n : ℝ) - 12 * (n : ℝ) + 1

claims.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.exerciseMean_eq_closedForm
claims.source_statement:
theorem exerciseMean_eq_closedForm [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs =
      Resources.QuickSortMean.closedForm xs.length

claims.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.exerciseMean_eq_harmonic
claims.source_statement:
theorem exerciseMean_eq_harmonic [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs =
      8 * ((xs.length : ℝ) + 1) * (harmonic xs.length : ℝ) -
        12 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 1

claims.name: Resources.RandomQuickSort.literalMean_harmonic_comparison
claims.source_statement:
theorem literalMean_harmonic_comparison [LinearOrder κ] (key : α → κ) (xs : List α)
    (hd : (xs.map key).Nodup) :
    8 * ((xs.length : ℝ) + 1) * (harmonic xs.length : ℝ) -
        12 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 1 ≤
      literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs ∧
    literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) xs ≤
      2 * (8 * ((xs.length : ℝ) + 1) * (harmonic xs.length : ℝ) -
        12 * (xs.length : ℝ) + 1)

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.empty_payload_means
claims.source_statement:
theorem empty_payload_means :
    exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] =
        8 * ((0 : ℝ) + 1) * (harmonic 0 : ℝ) - 12 * (0 : ℝ) + 1 ∧
      exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] = 1 ∧
      literalMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] = 1

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.singleton_payload_means
claims.source_statement:
theorem singleton_payload_means {α : Type u} {κ : Type v} [LinearOrder κ]
    (key : α → κ) (x : α) :
    exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] = 5 ∧
      literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] = 8 ∧
      5 ≤ literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] ∧
      literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] ≤ 10

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.empty_log_boundary
claims.source_statement:
theorem empty_log_boundary (C : ℝ) :
    ¬ exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] ≤
        C * ((0 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 0) ∧
      ¬ literalMean (fun _ _ : Empty => false) [] ≤
        C * ((0 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 0)

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.singleton_log_boundary
claims.source_statement:
theorem singleton_log_boundary {α : Type u} {κ : Type v} [LinearOrder κ]
    (key : α → κ) (x : α) (C : ℝ) :
    ¬ exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] ≤
        C * ((1 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 1) ∧
      ¬ literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) [x] ≤
        C * ((1 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 1)

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.four_tagged_harmonic
claims.source_statement:
theorem four_tagged_harmonic {α : Type u} (a b c d : α) :
    exerciseMean (fun x y : Nat × α => decide (x.1 < y.1))
        [(3, a), (1, b), (0, c), (2, d)] = (109 : ℝ) / 3 ∧
      (109 : ℝ) / 3 ≤
        literalMean (fun x y : Nat × α => decide (x.1 < y.1))
          [(3, a), (1, b), (0, c), (2, d)] ∧
      literalMean (fun x y : Nat × α => decide (x.1 < y.1))
          [(3, a), (1, b), (0, c), (2, d)] ≤ (218 : ℝ) / 3

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.arbitrary_length_indexed_growth
claims.source_statement:
theorem arbitrary_length_indexed_growth {α : Type u} {κ : Type v} [LinearOrder κ]
    (key : α → κ) (xs : Nat → List α)
    (hd : ∀ n, ((xs n).map key).Nodup) (hlen : ∀ n, (xs n).length = n) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n => exerciseMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) (xs n))
        (fun n : Nat => (n : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n => literalMean (fun a b => decide (key a < key b)) (xs n))
        (fun n : Nat => (n : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.function_tagged_family_growth
claims.source_statement:
theorem function_tagged_family_growth (tags : Nat → Nat → (Nat → Nat)) :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n => exerciseMean (fun a b : Nat × (Nat → Nat) => decide (a.1 < b.1))
          ((List.range n).map (fun k => (k, tags n k))))
        (fun n : Nat => (n : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n => literalMean (fun a b : Nat × (Nat → Nat) => decide (a.1 < b.1))
          ((List.range n).map (fun k => (k, tags n k))))
        (fun n : Nat => (n : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.shifted_range_family_growth
claims.source_statement:
theorem shifted_range_family_growth :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n : Nat => exerciseMean natLt (List.range (n + 2)))
        (fun n : Nat => ((n + 2 : Nat) : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 ((n + 2 : Nat) : ℝ)) ∧
      Asymptotics.IsBigO Filter.atTop
        (fun n : Nat => literalMean natLt (List.range (n + 2)))
        (fun n : Nat => ((n + 2 : Nat) : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 ((n + 2 : Nat) : ℝ))

    ([0, 1, 2] : List Nat).Nodup ∧
      ¬ (([0, 1, 2] : List Nat).map (fun _ => (7 : Nat))).Nodup ∧
      exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Nat => false) [0, 1, 2] = 25 ∧
      exerciseMean (fun _ _ : Nat => false) [0, 1, 2] ≠

claims.name: Examples.RandomQuickSortGrowth.equal_key_family_means
claims.source_statement:
theorem equal_key_family_means {α : Type u} (tags : List α) :
    exerciseMean (fun _ _ : α => false) tags =
        ((2 * tags.length ^ 2 + 2 * tags.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ) ∧
      literalMean (fun _ _ : α => false) tags =
        ((2 * tags.length ^ 2 + 5 * tags.length + 1 : Nat) : ℝ)
